title: Draft: UI: Support extcap-only interface lists.
description:
Add extcap_only arguments to fill_in_local_interfaces and
scan_local_interfaces. Set it to false for Wireshark and true for
Logwolf.

Copy dumpcap into Logwolf's application bundle.

notes.body:
Something about this feels "off". If we introduce too many distinctions between the two applications, maintenance will get that much harder in the future.

What would make sense though is, that instead of passing a boolean, you pass a list of interface types to "capture_interface_list" which in turn if empty returns all interfaces found, or just the ones filtered by the list. Then you can in the future introduce additional capture types (remote capture maybe) and this code would stay identical. 

Also, it would remove the need for the boolean gate here, as the filtering happens where it should and we do not introduce one more position where capture interfaces are being handled.
We need to do this in a way that doesn't interfere with the `gui.interfaces_hidden_types` preference as well.
Let me take a crack at it. I‘ve got an idea
I've uploaded my version at !6694. The difference being, that that version allows filtering on any specific list of types and not being extcap specific.
